title: Predicting response to non-selective beta-blockers with liver-spleen stiffness and heart rate in patients with liver cirrhosis and high-risk varices
summary: A prospective study used LASSO logistic regression to select three-month percentage changes in spleen stiffness, liver stiffness and heart rate for predicting 12-month NSBB response in cirrhosis with high-risk varices. The combined model reached AUROC 0.96 in derivation and 0.91 in a separate geographic validation cohort. This supports a bounded prediction result, not proof of improved care or HVPG-confirmed response. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
